nuisance.definition: n. (law) a broad legal concept including anything that disturbs the reasonable use of your property or endangers life and health or is offensive
nuisance.translation:
n. 讨厌的东西, 讨厌的人, 损害
[医] 损害, 讨厌

nuisance or pyblic nuisance.translation: [法] 公共滋扰罪, 公害

nuisance order.translation: [法] 清除障碍令, 清除公害令

nuisance tax.translation:
小额消费品税
[法] 小额消费品税

nuisancer.definition: n. One who makes or causes a nuisance.
nuisancer.translation: n. 讨厌的人；损害；麻烦事；讨厌的东西 (nuisance的变形)
